provenance: Owner-approved opening and starter rules, implemented through prototype 013
current_build: Prototype 013; see PROTOTYPE-013.md and release validation for tested scope

capture_scene.placed_at: left Poké Ball on lab table

lab_table.approach: freestanding table on right side of Oak's lab, in the spirit of Yellow
lab_table.interaction: approach a physical Poké Ball, inspect starter, confirm or decline

gender_selection_policy: Starter gender is independent of chosen player gender. Force via per-Pokémon personality/gender at creation, never by globally modifying species base data.

rival_visuals.kanto: Blue for overworld and battle assets; player-named rival

johto_preservation.starter_selection: keep original HeartGold presentation for later Johto event
johto_preservation.future_exception: eight Johto gym leaders scale by badge order as previously agreed

release_policy: Publish a patch and local-only automatic browser downloader. The user selects their own HeartGold ROM; the finished NDS is created and downloaded on that device. Never upload ROMs, including ZIPs, to GitHub.

shiny_chance.interpretation: Current-generation base shiny odds requested by owner

perfect_six_iv_bonus.rule: On bonus success all six are 31. Otherwise each IV is independent and uniformly random 0..31; accidental natural 6IV also remains possible.

generation_iv.shiny_rule: OT_ID low16 xor OT_ID high16 xor PID low16 xor PID high16 < 8
generation_iv.gender_rule: species personal-data gender threshold vs PID low byte

starter_creation.non_starter_scope: Leave ordinary wild and NPC Pokémon creation unchanged
starter_creation.integration_status: Live Thumb-1 implementation in starter_properties.py; native DS validation in progress.

ability_slots.chance_policy: Uniform 1-in-3 for each of three ability slots (per starter gift only). Hidden Ability must be flagged for evolution to preserve or map to the correct evolved third ability.
ability_slots.gen4_engine_status: All nine ability IDs exist natively; third species slot and Hidden Ability inheritance do not exist in stock HeartGold.
ability_slots.method: Design-stage Kanto-only creation/evolution hooks must set an available ability explicitly, retain a third-slot marker through saves, and bypass stock UpdateMonAbility only where an existing Hidden Ability maps to the evolved species. No such hook has been integrated yet.
ability_slots.evolution_note: Map starter Hidden Ability to the evolved species' own Hidden Ability ONLY when that ability exists in stock HeartGold. Espeon's Magic Bounce is absent: on evolution let HeartGold recalculate its native Synchronize and discard any third-slot state. Non-hidden Pokémon use original HeartGold evolution mechanics. Preserve vanilla Johto and wild encounters.
ability_slots.cross_game_scope: Do not change Johto starter selection, wild Pokémon, general ability slots, or Silver.
ability_slots.compatibility_policy: Give third-slot Hidden Abilities only if the exact effect is already implemented in the original HeartGold engine. Never add Gen V+ abilities, substitute a different Hidden Ability, or modify globally shared Pokémon data.

future_pokemon_policy.scope: Deferred. Do not mass-edit the Pokédex or native species abilities.
future_pokemon_policy.trigger: Only when an additional Pokémon becomes relevant to story/gameplay and the supervisor asks for it
future_pokemon_policy.guard: Enable its Hidden Ability only if that exact effect is implemented in unmodified HeartGold; otherwise preserve its normal HeartGold abilities.
future_pokemon_policy.implementation: Use targeted changes per species or event; never rewrite all Pokémon globally.

rival_starter_properties.eevee_evolution: ask owner before implementing first evolved encounter
rival_starter_properties.psyduck_togepi_evolution: normal species evolutions when later battles are implemented

global_shiny_rules.legendary_scope: Only existing Yellow and HeartGold/SoulSilver encounter species, including native Sinjoh encounters
